title: The Button That Must Be Held: An Enable Switch, Key Repeat That Looks Like Letting Go, and a Robot That Must Not Start by Itself
fallback: This lesson is about the keys an operator holds to move a robot, so it needs Qt Gui. Lesson 07-14 is about asking work to stop and lesson 05-04 about inputs you did not think of, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: an enable key that is held and not tapped, and an interlock that allows speed only while the key is held, the link is alive and no emergency stop has been pressed, and never restarts by itself
